## Summary

Population grew **2.1%** last year, and jobs grew faster than housing across the four counties. This page is rendered to PDF with `format: wfrc-brand-typst`: the logo, colors and fonts come from `brand.yml`.

::: {.callout-note}
## Note
PTI is unitless. A value of 1.5 means a 20-minute free-flow trip needs 30 minutes of budget.
:::

## Findings

### Travel modes

| Mode | Share |
|------|------:|
| Drive | 78% |
| Transit | 4% |
| Walk and bike | 5% |

### Method

The score combines reach and jobs:

$$ \text{score} = 0.6 \cdot \text{reach} + 0.4 \cdot \text{jobs} $$

```r
gaps |> mutate(score = rescale(reach) * 0.6 + rescale(jobs) * 0.4)
```
